limitations: Several staged matrix/origin calculations fit all selected alpha samples. A fit does not identify the actual source-device origin or justify a production transform.

Keeping the original noninteger filter region resamples feImage before restoration; its texels cannot be assumed to equal the embedded PNG. A one-float-step increase of source scale changes up to 16 of 588 checked texels. Such a carrier is not proof of the original Gaussian intermediate.

Making the mask opaque and varying source geometry preserves the selected diagnostic output, but the diagnostic graph has its own bounds and allocation requests. Preserve original white and black controls and independent end-to-end acceptance.
